en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It  is  narrated  by  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  from  his predecessors  from  Abu  Zar  (r.a.)  that  the  Holy  Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “
The longer the Qunoot of a person in this world, the longer would be his peace in Mauqif (stages) on the Day of Judgment.”
